listing.title: A & T Construction
listing.summary: Concrete, excavation, and general contracting website package for Rupert and Mini-Cassia, Idaho.
listing.description: A & T Construction is packaged as a Workers-backed local-service stub for concrete flatwork, excavation/trenching, grading/drainage, foundations, and general contracting around Rupert and Mini-Cassia. The site includes editable content, conversion-focused services and project highlight sections, generated visual assets, a BusinessStub chatbot widget, and server-side inquiry + chatbot proxy routes ready for intake once the Worker secret is configured.
listing.value_proposition: A clean, modern web presence gives rural property owners and builders a simple way to request quotes and describe job details—without relying on a directory profile alone.
listing.seo_description: Concrete flatwork, excavation, and general contracting in Rupert and Mini-Cassia. Request a quote.
listing.internal_notes: Prospect #102. Selected as top-scoring eligible prospect (score 138) on 2026-05-17. Source evidence: YellowPages contractor category in Rupert, ID; notes indicate a LocalSearch profile at atconstructionid.localsearch.com and public phone (208) 436-0738. Domain field reflects the directory/LocalSearch URL for matching context; domain ownership is not verified and is not included as a transferable asset. Design differentiation: light stone/concrete aesthetic with sticky glass header, AT monogram, hero split-layout, trust chips, line-icon service cards, and a combined service-area + quote form panel—visually distinct from prior dark excavation stubs. Build pattern: standalone Workers-backed static site with build-time site-editor content, same-origin /api/inquiry + /api/chatbot proxy routes, and generated visual assets. GitHub repository will be set after repo creation. Worker preview will be set after deployment. STUB_INTAKE_KEY is intentionally blank in this committed JSON and must be set as a Worker secret + included only in the import payload.

operations.chatbot_greeting: Ask a question about concrete, excavation, or getting an estimate.
operations.chatbot_knowledge: Services: concrete flatwork (driveways, slabs, pads, sidewalks, approach work), excavation/trenching (footings, utilities, site prep), foundations (forms/rebar/pours), grading & drainage, small builds & repairs (retaining walls/steps/repairs), and general contracting. Service area: Rupert and Mini-Cassia, plus nearby towns like Burley, Heyburn, Declo, Acequia, and Minidoka. For a quote: share job address, service needed, timing, access constraints, and any photos or rough dimensions if available.
operations.chatbot_lead_prompt: If you want a follow-up, share your name, phone number, job location, and what you need done.
